messages:
maya: Quick sync — ACME asked for 7y immutable audit exports + BYOK escrow in EU1 + us-west. Also wants SOC2 evidence bundle.
sam: Ack. Biggest questions: how do we guarantee immutability for 7 years and what search/restore SLAs do we promise?
jeff: Right now we keep hot index 90d, cold archive beyond that. We don't currently offer an immutable flag on objects.
maya: Thinking short-term: offer an "export bundle" (parquet + manifest) for legal retention, plus a long-term object store with retention metadata.
legal: @maya We need explicit contract language for legal_hold and chain-of-custody. Can the API expose a non-deletable retention flag?
sam: We can implement retention flag, but ops needs tooling to prevent accidental restores/deletes and to audit every access. Cost + ops overhead will grow.
jeff: KMS escrow: current BYOK handshake is single-region. Multi-region escrow will require escrow key sync + monthly verification flow. Security review mandatory.
maya: Draft launch criteria (proposal):
- Export format: parquet + manifest + signature
- Retention API: retention_ttl + legal_hold boolean (immutable)
- KMS handshake doc + escrow verification process
- SOC2 evidence export runner + provenance metadata
Any objections?
sam: Trade-offs: storage + retrieval cost est +40% for long-term holdings, search restore RTO 24-72h depending on restore window. Need exec sign-off on costs.
jeff: Tech plan: prototype export runner spike (2w) to validate format and restore path. Add KMS escrow spike (3w) for multi-region handshake.
maya: Actions: jeff -> prototype export runner (INF-5321), sam -> ops cost calc and restore runbook, legal -> draft contract clauses for immutable retention and escrow verification.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5321: "ACME retention + BYOK escrow pilot" assigned to jeff, sam, legal.
maya: Follow-up Friday 11:00 PT. Tagging @sam @jeff @legal :thumbsup:
